children.contents:
I've often said that if I wasn't into tech, then I would be doing music.

I play piano (RCM 10) and drums, but I dabble in guitar and bass as well.
I've uploaded a bunch of covers on my primary instagram @artb_64.
I am also good at playing by ear and have hundreds of short covers on my second account @c_major._

In past years, I've been really getting into music theory and production.
Would really like to start a band someday!
